name_reason: Name already follows convention and reflects purpose + data type. Prefix data_fd2_battle_ (battle core table), domain summon_spell, 8slot is a domain descriptor (the logical 8-slot orbit; sibling tables _8slot_visibility_table and _8slot_row_multiplier_table use the same descriptor) -- NOT an address residue (0x523e8 != 8). y_offset_table accurately reflects a per-slot Y (vertical) pixel offset table. The table physically holds 7 entries (slot 8 has no offset entry); '8slot' names the conceptual orbit, consistent with the sibling family.
purpose: Per-slot baseline vertical (Y) pixel offset table for the summon-spell stage-0 orbit setup cinematic.
logic_summary: Read-only const table of 7 u32 Y offsets. Sole consumer fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot @ 0x26152 REP MOVSDs all 7 dwords into a stack local (ECX=7), biases every slot by +0x94 px when the caster is on the enemy team (runtime_char[caster].bTeam == 0), then forms each per-slot blit Y coordinate as y = row_multiplier[slot]*row_stride + origin_y + y_offset[slot]. The mutation (+0x94) is applied only to the stack copy, never the table itself.
element_semantics: Each element is a per-slot baseline vertical (Y) pixel offset added into the sprite blit Y coordinate. Values { 40, 70, 120, 80, 50, 100, 70 } (0x28,0x46,0x78,0x50,0x32,0x64,0x46), all small positive offsets added into a signed int Y.
comment_original_issue: The line directly above the declaration read '/* Non-const for the same reason as the visibility sibling above. */', which contradicted the actual 'const uint32' declaration and the data's read-only nature (zero game-side write xrefs; the consumer only bulk-copies it out and mutates only its stack-local copy). The descriptive comment block above it was otherwise accurate and precise.
notes: Verified the source comment's disassembly claims against fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot @ 0x26152: REP MOVSD x7 (ECX=7) from 0x523e8 to [ESP+0x1c]; enemy bias 'ADD dword ptr [ESP+EBX*0x4+0x1c],0x94' gated by bTeam (offset +6) == 0; blit Y math y = row_multiplier[slot]*row_stride(IMUL signed,EBP) + origin_y + y_offset[slot] (the post-PUSH stack offsets +0x24/+0x8 confirm which copy is which). read_memory confirms values {40,70,120,80,50,100,70}. The only xrefs are the READ/DATA copy pair at 0x26185/0x2618a (no writers) -> is_const=true confirmed. Ghidra data plate at 0x523e8 was empty (null); created a concise plate (src conclusion as authority) via PLATE_COMMENT field. Adjacent siblings (visibility @0x523E1, row_multiplier @0x52404) carry the same stale 'Non-const' comment line but are out of scope for this symbol; left untouched.
